```{r}
# install.packages("RSQLite")
library(DBI, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(RSQLite, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(mlr3, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(mlr3pipelines, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(mlr3learners, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(mlr3viz, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(ggplot2, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(paradox, warn.conflicts = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# Creating the database
if (file.exists("r_airline5.db")) 
  file.remove("r_airline5.db")

conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "r_airline5.db")
```

```{r}
###For loop to write a table for each year
for(i in c(2001)) {
  filename <- paste0(i, ".csv.bz2")
  print(paste("Processing:", i))
  arrived1 <- read.csv(filename, header = TRUE, encoding = "latin1", stringsAsFactor=FALSE)
  if(i == 2001) {
    dbWriteTable(conn, "arrived1", arrived1, append = TRUE)
  } 
}
for(i in c(2002)) {
  filename <- paste0(i, ".csv.bz2")
  print(paste("Processing:", i))
  arrived2 <- read.csv(filename, header = TRUE, encoding = "latin1", stringsAsFactor=FALSE)
  if(i == 2002) {
    dbWriteTable(conn, "arrived2", arrived2, append = TRUE)
  } 
}
arrived <- rbind(arrived1,arrived2)
```

```{r}
#Generating sample size
df1 <- sample_n(arrived, 100000)
#Replace NA with zero
df1[is.na(df1)] <- 0
```


```{r} 
#Convert DepDelay into either 1 (true) / 0 (false)
dt1 <- df1 %>%
  mutate(DepDelay = replace(DepDelay, DepDelay <= 0, 0), DepDelay = replace(DepDelay, DepDelay > 0, 1))

#Make dataframe
df2 <- select(dt1, DepDelay, Cancelled, Diverted, Year, Month, DayofMonth, DayOfWeek)
# Convert data type to factor
df3 <- df2
for(i in 1:ncol(df3)){
  df3[ , i] <- factor(df3[ , i])
}
```


```{r}
#Install if warning " object tnr is not found" is triggered
#install.packages('mlr3tuning')
#library(mlr3tuning)
n <- nrow(df3)



set.seed(100)
tr_num <- sample(n, round(0.5*n))  # Train set
test_num <- setdiff(1:n, tr_num) # Test set
tuner <- tnr('grid_search')
terminator <- trm('evals', n_evals = 20)

```


```{r}
task <- TaskClassif$new('Delayed', backend = df3, target = 'DepDelay')
task$select(c('Cancelled','Diverted', 'Year', 'Month', 'DayofMonth', 'DayOfWeek'))
```


```{r}
measure <- msr('classif.ce') #Set measure
faccode <- po("encode", method="treatment",        
               affect_columns=selector_type("factor")) #Encoding with factors
ord_to_int <- po("colapply", applicator=as.integer,
                 affect_columns=selector_type("ordered")) # Change ordered to integer

```


```{r}
#Logistic regression
lr_lnr <- lrn("classif.log_reg") 

lr_gc <- po('imputemean', affect_columns=selector_type("numeric")) %>>%
  po('imputemode', affect_columns=selector_type(c("factor","ordered"))) %>>%
  po(lr_lnr)  
lr_glnr <- GraphLearner$new(lr_gc) 

lr_glnr$train(task, row_ids = tr_num)
lr_glnr$predict(task, row_ids = test_num)$score()
```

```{r}
#Random Forest
#install.packages("ranger")
#library(ranger)
set.seed(123)
rf_lnr <- lrn('classif.ranger')
rf_lnr$param_set$values <- list(min.node.size=4)

rf_gc <- po('imputemean', affect_columns=selector_type("numeric")) %>>%
  po('imputemode', affect_columns=selector_type(c("factor","ordered"))) %>>%
  po(rf_lnr)

rf_glrn <- GraphLearner$new(rf_gc)

set_ntrees <- ParamSet$new (list(
  ParamInt$new('classif.ranger.num.trees', lower = 50, upper = 600)
))


rf_at <- AutoTuner$new(
  learner = rf_glrn,
  resampling = rsmp('cv', folds=3),
  measure = measure,
  search_space = set_ntrees,
  terminator = terminator,
  tuner = tuner
)

rf_at$train(task, row_ids = tr_num)
rf_at$predict(task, row_ids = test_num)$score() 

```

```{r}
#install.packages("xgboost")
#library(xgboost)

set.seed(10)

learner_gb <- lrn("classif.xgboost")

gc_gb <- po('imputemean', affect_columns=selector_type("numeric")) %>>%
  po('imputemode', affect_columns=selector_type(c("factor","ordered"))) %>>%
  faccode %>>% ord_to_int %>>%
  po(learner_gb)

glrn_gb <- GraphLearner$new(gc_gb)

glrn_gb$train(task, row_ids = tr_num)
glrn_gb$predict(task, row_ids = test_num)$score() 
```

```{r}
learner_tree <- lrn("classif.rpart")

gc_tree <- po('imputemean', affect_columns=selector_type("numeric")) %>>%
  po('imputemode', affect_columns=selector_type(c("factor","ordered"))) %>>%
  po(learner_tree)

glrn_tree <- GraphLearner$new(gc_tree)

glrn_tree$train(task, row_ids = tr_num)
glrn_tree$predict(task, row_ids = test_num)$score() 
```

```{r}
#Benchmarking both learners

set.seed(1)

list_lnr <- list(
  lr_glnr,
  rf_at,
  glrn_gb,
  glrn_tree
)

bm_design <- benchmark_grid(task=task, resamplings=rsmp('cv', folds=3), 
                            learners=list_lnr)
bmr <- benchmark(bm_design, store_models=TRUE)
```

```{r}
#Visualise with boxplot
autoplot(bmr) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
bmr$aggregate(measure)
```
